title: njikọ aka ahụ nke kpọtara mbibi
intro: Chee echiche otú e si chebe gị n'okpuru otu ụlọ ahụ dị ka ihe e kpughere, ma họrọ iguzosi ike n'ihe dị iche. Onye a biri ndụ nso n'eziokwu na ịbụ onye amụma, mana ọ tụgharịrị gaa n'ebe ndị jụrụ ya nọ. Akụkọ ha dị ka ịdọ aka ná ntị siri ike na nso ezi omume nanị agaghị azọpụta mkpụrụ obi nke na-emebi ntụkwasị obi ahụ.
clues: Ebi m n'ụlọ onye amụma nke Allah họpụtara.
Amaara m eziokwu di m kwuru, mana ekwenyeghị m ya nke ọma.
Egburu m ntụkwasị obi ya site n'ịnọnyere ndị ọ jụrụ ma nyere ha aka megide ya.
A kpọtụrụ m aha ya na nwunye onye amụma ọzọ onye raara onwe ya nye, dịka ihe atụ nye ndị na-ekweghị ekwe.
Akụkọ m dị na Surah At-Tahrim dịka ịdọ aka ná ntị na inwe mmekọrịta na ndị amụma anaghị echebe mmadụ.
M nwụrụ n'etiti ndị ajọ omume mgbe Allah bibiri ndị Lut, fọdụrụ na ndị fọdụrụ.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
